dependencies.rule: PIR/EIR/MIDP/TIDP and LOD/LOI determine which containers exist, delivery timing, and segmentation demand; S4 creates deterministic identities for those containers.
S8 supplies semantic parameter definitions and the Shared Parameter Registry; S4 may consume those values as identity carriers without redefining semantic ownership.
S4 governs names and identity of files and containers placed within S3 CDE structures.
S4 discipline, system, zone, and level identity tokens support coordination filters, clash sets, and issue attribution.
Stable S4 container identity propagates into formal transmittal and handover records while revision and suitability remain separate mutable dimensions.

resolved_by_curator.resolution: Seven-token hyphen-delimited grammar is canonical cross-platform root identity; ACC underscore scheme is an implementation/display mapping.
3-4 letter discipline codes govern enterprise/container identity; compact codes remain valid only in explicitly governed tool-local contexts.
Revision and suitability/status are mutable governed dimensions and do not redefine canonical root identity.
